title: Free-fall displacement
description: Essential: Correctly calculates h₁ = ½gt₁² = 180 m.

title: Free-fall velocity
description: Essential: Correctly calculates v = gt₁ = 60 m/s.

title: Deceleration displacement
description: Important: Uses h₂ = H - h₁ = 120 m to find remaining distance.

title: Deceleration time
description: Important: Applies h₂ = ½vt₂ to solve for t₂ = 4 s.

title: Total time
description: Essential: Correctly sums t = t₁ + t₂ = 10 s.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect sign for acceleration during deceleration phase.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (m, m/s, s) throughout solution.
